component.name: Dustshot
component.summary: Wayland screenshot, annotation, OCR and pinboard tool

description.p: Dustshot captures the screen on Wayland compositors that speak wlr-screencopy, annotates the result, decodes text, QR codes and barcodes, and keeps shots on screen as floating pins.

ul.li: Region capture on a frozen backdrop, with a magnifier, size label and handle resizing
An editor with rectangles, ellipses, lines, arrows, pen, highlighter, text, serial numbers, mosaic and blur
A pinboard: several always-on-top snippets, draggable, zoomable, snappable, click-through and adjustable in opacity
Text recognition through tesseract, QR and barcode decoding through zbar
Region or whole-output recording with wf-recorder, optionally converted to GIF

description.p: Snap a region to the borders of the windows and controls behind it, crop and rotate the picture in the editor, and send a pinned image back into the editor from the new edit button.
First release: region capture, annotation editor, pinboard, OCR, barcode decoding, capture history and screen recording.
